name: twzrd-x402-gate
description: Buyer-side x402 trust gate. Run a free TWZRD preflight (ReadinessCard) before signing USDC to any x402 merchant, and autonomously escalate a `warn` to a $0.001 paid trust check that re-decides — blocking the spend on bad paid intel, no human in the loop. Wraps fetch (HTTP 402) and the @x402/mcp onPaymentRequested hook. BREAKING(0.2.0): fail-closed by default — set TWZRD_FAIL_OPEN=true to restore legacy allow-on-outage behavior.

scripts.test: tsx test/policy.test.ts && tsx test/wrap-fetch.test.ts && tsx test/mcp-hook.test.ts && tsx test/attribution.test.ts && tsx test/auto-receipt.test.ts && tsx test/quick.test.ts && tsx test/sponsored.test.ts && tsx test/escalation.test.ts
